_about: 2-Methoxyethanol (1) + N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 95.3 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-methoxyethanol, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: K. R. Reddy, D. B. K. Kumar, G. S. Rao, P. B. S. Sri, C. Rambabu, Vapor-liquid equilibria and excess molar volumes of N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone with 2-alkoxyethanols, Fluid Phase Equilib. 336 (2012) 52-58
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 9, 11. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.63 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
